author: KEXP
description: Combining chastushka intonations and folklore motifs, Ukrainian band Vopli Vidopliasova take the KEXP Studios with a performance of "Кармен (Carmen)" and more.
title: Vopli Vidopliasova performs "Кармен (Carmen)" & more Live on KEXP
